title: Special forces guys play 'Hunter Skinwalker' at the ranch

tellings.quote: these three guys, the armed guys, the special forces guys that went on there and they were going to play, you know, Hunter Skinwalker

plain: Skinwalker Ranch is a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings. On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a guest named Grant Cameron passed on a story he says came from a man named Brandon Fugal: three armed men, described as special forces soldiers, went onto the ranch planning to play what he calls "Hunter Skinwalker", meaning they meant to hunt down whatever was there. The story is told because it would suggest the place is serious enough to draw trained soldiers.
